//: tsconfig.json builds src/ into dist/ and pins rootDir to src, which is correct
for the long-lived server but excludes api/index.ts — the Vercel serverless
handler, which sits outside src by requirement of the platform's file
convention. That file imports from ../src, so a config with rootDir: src
This config drops rootDir and adds api/ so `npm run lint` proves both
entrypoints compile. It emits nothing; the build still uses tsconfig.json.
Without it, the handler that actually runs in production would be the one part
of the backend no check ever looked at.
